contradictions.what: Rep first named Maya as final decider, then revealed Greg held the contract and signed; revised to split between Maya and Greg.
Rep thought they were there to keep incumbent honest until the data session, yet it signed four days later.
Rep gives a third-of-churn figure but disclaims it, while saying it is in the board deck.
Customer questions turned to hardware, yet the pitch reaction was to failed payment recovery rather than hardware.

dodges.question: Last one. What exact words did they—

outcome_signals.what: Won: contract signed by Greg four days after the data session.
Partial win: only memberships and online billing signed; front-desk studios are phase two and still on Global.
Phase two has no date and depends on the partner integration, which customer only saw as a partner demo.
